description: A shallow and a deep history state of one compound state, `Work`. With nothing recorded, a transition from inside `Work` to its shallow history state enters `Work`'s initial state, `Draft`, again, leaving `Work` itself alone. Leaving `Work` records its active child (`Review`) and its active leaf (`Comment`), before anything is exited; a transition to the deep history state enters every state down to `Comment`, whose invoke and timer start again with new ids, and one to the shallow history state enters `Review` by its default entry. A transition written on `Work` to its own deep history state leaves `Work`, recording where it was, and enters it again as it was. From inside `Work`, a transition to its history state enters what was recorded when `Work` was last left (`Review`), not where it is now (`Draft`), and records nothing, since `Work` is not left. The saved snapshot holds both records.
